67f2089221: After Dad got out of the Navy in Dec, 1945, he went to work for Trailmobile as a welder. He said he enjoyed welding more than any other job. However, after a few years he began selling cars and continued that for the remainer of his working life. He worked for a number of new car dealers over the years. In the mid '50's, he opened a used car lot at 1006 Booneville, where he operated his car lot for 8-10 years. I worked there off and on during my teen years. In about 1967, Dad and Austin Grisham opened the Dodge-Plymouth agency in Branson and later a second dealership in Ozark. They sold the agencies in the late 70s. Dad continued to occasionaly sell used cars until the onset of dementia. Mom and Dad moved back to Springfield in the mid 80s, living on south Patton Street. He went into assisted care in about 1994 and died in 1997. Dad loved hunting and fishing, but his true sport was golf. He was a par shooter all of his life, having learned when he was a caddy as a teenage. He was on the Springfield Men's Amateur Golf team for awhile and set several course records for below par scores at Grandview Golf Course. In Branson, he was a member of the golf club near their farmette just east of Branson, winning many tournaments there. Mom was a homemaker. They were both wonderful parents.
